frozen: 2026-10-29, before any outcome of any event below was computed or read
owner_instruction: speedrun: answer in days, from history, whether the machine can tell which spiking stocks make their own pump, dump or next-day move, and which free features help
question: Among the Speculation Register's own spiking stocks, does a model fitted on earlier years tell apart, on later years, the ones that make the move on their own (most twins do not)? Which free feature blocks add discrimination?

data.sealed: US and crypto 2024 onward, IDX 2024-01-02..2025-02-21: rows outside rows_read are dropped before any market is built; each IDX segment is built from its own rows only

detector.IDX: F1_ARA (moonshot_e1): close locked at the upper auto-rejection limit, close >= Rp50

events.eligible: tradeable on the signal session, more than 20 present sessions of history in the segment, and at least 21 sessions of the segment after it (20-session windows inside)
events.population_note: every eligible detector event, not only the live register's executable subset (the live NOT EXECUTABLE rule depends on a policy version and on live quotes)

counts_at_freeze.note: feasibility count of detector events only; no outcome read

split.test: signal sessions from 2023-01-01 (US and crypto 2023; IDX 2023 and the whole 2025-02-24.. segment)
split.rule: everything fitted (scaling, model, context tables, anchors) uses train rows only; test rows are scored once

twins: speculation.draw_twins on the session's own feature frame (the scan's columns: fresh, eligible, the detector flag, close, previous, adv20_value, ret20, dd60, volr), 5 twins, seed speculation.twin_seed('PATH-HISTORY-v1:<market>:<session>:<ticker>')

outcomes.BASE5: speculation.simulate with the register's plan (entry_window 1, holding 5) for the stock and each twin; crypto entry quote = the open of the next UTC day (the live register uses a quote at sealing time)
outcomes.cone: speculation.statement_outcome: RUN30_5, FADE10_5, GAIN0_5, BEATS_TWINS_5, RUN30_20, DOUBLE_20, with the twins' rate as in speculation.cone_outcomes
outcomes.own_moves: as learner2.own_move: PUMP30_k = RUN30_k on its own, PUMP100_20 = DOUBLE_20 on its own, DUMP10_5 = FADE10_5 on its own, PUMP_AND_DUMP_5 = both PUMP30_5 and DUMP10_5; on its own = fewer than half of the graded twins made the same move; ungraded when it happened and no twin was graded

next_session.r1: level(d+1) / level(d) - 1 on the split-adjusted level, the session after the signal; ungraded when the stock has no bar at d+1
next_session.NEXT_DUMP10: r1 <= -0.10 on its own (fewer than half of the twins with a bar at d+1 have r1 <= -0.10)
next_session.NEXT_LOSES: r1 below the median r1 of the twins with a bar at d+1 (at least 3)

features.P0: the learner's own price features for a speculation set (learner2.features with direction +1): s_ret1, s_ret5, s_ret20, s_dd60, log_volr, s_cpos, log_adv
features.P1: P0 plus, from the stock's bars through the close of d: gap (open / previous close - 1), vol20 (20-session sd of log returns), log_price, spikes60 (detector days of the stock in the 60 sessions before d), streak (consecutive up closes ending at d, capped at 10), dist_high252 (level / its 252-session max - 1), log_age (log of present sessions so far), breadth (log1p of the market's detector events on d), mkt_ret (the market's median day return on d); IDX also ara_streak (consecutive ARA closes ending at d)
features.E_US: P1 plus, for US stocks, EDGAR and FINRA data published before 09:00 New York of d+1 (the entry open): news (an 8-K, 8-K/A or 6-K accepted after 16:00 New York of d-1), offering90 (S-1, S-1/A, S-1MEF, F-1, F-1/A, S-3, F-3, S-3ASR, 424B1, 424B3, 424B4 or 424B5 accepted in the 90 days before), shelf3y (S-3, F-3 or S-3ASR in the 3 years before), atm12m (424B5 in the 365 days before), revsplit12m (a reverse split in the 252 sessions before: the panel's as-traded level jumps by 1.5x or more at a provider split record), short_ratio (FINRA Reg SHO consolidated daily file for d: ShortVolume / TotalVolume) and short_abn (short_ratio minus the stock's median over its previous 20 files), log_turnover (as-traded volume on d / shares outstanding from the XBRL frame dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding of the latest calendar quarter that ended at least 120 days before d; missing when a split record falls between that quarter end and d), log_shares, has_edgar, has_short, has_shares
features.CONTEXT: P1 plus a context prior per statement (the keyboard idea: a smoothed frequency of what followed the same context in training, like a language model's next-word probability): context = (market, spikes60 0/1/2+, streak 1/2/3+, gap <10%/10-30%/>=30%, and for US news 0/1 and offering90-or-atm12m 0/1); P_ctx = (hits + 20 p_market) / (n + 20) over train rows (leave-one-out for train rows themselves); feature = logit(P_ctx) - logit(p_market)
features.missing: a missing value is 0 after scaling, with its has_ flag where listed

model.form: penalised logistic regression per statement and feature block: shared slopes plus market-specific deviations, market intercepts; E_US on US rows only
model.penalties: features standardised on train rows; precision 16 on shared slopes, 25 on market deviations, 1/1.5^2 on intercepts (learner2's LAMBDA_SHARED, LAMBDA_TASK, LAMBDA_ICPT); nothing tuned
model.fit: Newton with step-halving to a gradient norm below 1e-8; an error on non-convergence
model.anchor: the train base rate of the statement per market (climatology)

evaluation.on: test rows with the statement graded
evaluation.metrics: AUC (Mann-Whitney); Brier gain over the anchor (mean of anchor Brier - model Brier) and Brier skill (1 - model / anchor); per statement and block, pooled and per market
evaluation.uncertainty: cluster bootstrap over ISO weeks of the signal session, 2000 resamples, seed 20261029; one-sided p for AUC <= 0.5 = (resamples with AUC <= 0.5 + 1) / 2001
evaluation.increments: paired cluster-bootstrap delta AUC of each block over P0 (P1, CONTEXT pooled; E_US against P1 on US rows), 95% interval

decision_rule.primary: for each primary statement, block P1 pooled: LEARNABLE when Holm over the four primary statements at 0.05 rejects AUC <= 0.5 and the test Brier gain over the anchor is above zero; otherwise NOT_LEARNABLE_WITH_THESE_FEATURES (not a verdict on the goal)
decision_rule.blocks: descriptive: a block adds when its paired delta-AUC 95% interval is above zero
decision_rule.speed: descriptive: each LEARNABLE statement's test AUC is read against the gate simulations committed with this study (weekly gate and daily next-session gate) for the expected time until the live learner can earn confidence

use: design input for a separately frozen LEARNER v2.3: which feature blocks enter, and a PATH warm start from these events (capped as the v2.2 warm start is). Nothing here changes a live ledger, prior, twin draw, family rule or frozen protocol; v2.3 is judged on its own prospective record
limitations: US prices are survivor-only (Nasdaq Trader snapshot of 2026-10-08): names delisted before then are absent, and the worst dumps are among them
crypto pairs that Binance dropped from exchangeInfo are absent
daily bars only: no intraday path, no halts
crypto entry at the next day's open, not a sealing-time quote
8-K timing approximates news: a press release without an 8-K is missed
shares outstanding lag the signal by at least 120 days, which understates the float after recent dilution
FINRA consolidated short volume includes market makers' short sales
IDX 2025-2026 has many more ARA days than 2019-2023: a regime change the out-of-time test includes on purpose
